rule: holographic positioning: one vote per valid CYOA scroll holding the word; coordinate = component-wise average, rounded half up, min 1

placement_legend.cyoa: averaged from the CYOA scrolls holding the word
placement_legend.home: 1.1.1/1.1.1/1.1.1 — in the archive, not in CYOA
placement_legend.far: 9.9.9/9.9.9/9.9.9 — in neither the archive nor CYOA; no row is stored, absence from atlas.tsv is the record, and the page rests such words at the far corner at runtime
